lockup.summary: Directors, officers and almost all other holders cannot sell their shares for 180 days after the date of the prospectus. The lead underwriters can allow sales sooner by giving written consent.

what: It develops CRISPR gene-editing medicines meant to prevent common heart and metabolic diseases, starting with high cholesterol.
risks: It is a young company that has not finished any clinical trial and has no approved products, so its future is hard to judge.
It has lost money every period, has never earned product revenue, and expects to keep losing money.
Its management and auditors have serious doubt it can keep operating, because its cash will not last twelve months.
Even after this offering, it will need a lot more money, which may not be available on acceptable terms.
